updateTime.description: Timestamp of the last update of this consolidated document

key.description: Unique consolidated publication identifier (MD5 hash of the source interface name and product name)

name.description: Product name as delivered by the publishing interface

mission.description: Mission identifier the product belongs to (e.g. S1, S2, S3, S5)

satellite_unit.description: Satellite unit that produced the product (e.g. S1A, S2B)

sensing_start_date.description: Sensing start date of the product observation window

sensing_end_date.description: Sensing end date of the product observation window

sensing_duration.description: Length of the sensing window, in microseconds (sensing_end_date minus sensing_start_date)

fos_pushing_date_backup.description: Date the product was pushed by the FOS through the backup channel

fos_pushing_date_nominal.description: Date the product was pushed by the FOS through the nominal channel

service_type.description: Type of the production/dissemination service that published the product

service_id.description: Identifier/name of the production/dissemination service that published the product

product_uuid.description: UUID of the product on the publishing service

centre.description: Processing centre parsed from the product name (S3-specific)

platform.description: Platform identifier parsed from the product name (S3-specific)

content_length.description: Size of the published product content, in bytes

origin_date.description: Date the product became available at the producer (origin) before publication

publication_date.description: Date the product was published on the service

modification_date.description: Date the product was last modified on the publishing service

eviction_date.description: Date the product is scheduled to be evicted from the publishing service

publication_count.description: Number of publications recorded for the product

from_sensing_time.description: Time between sensing end and publication, in seconds

transfer_time.description: Transfer time of the product, in seconds

within_from_sensing_timeliness.description: Whether the publication met the from-sensing timeliness target, as a percentage

within_transfer_timeliness.description: Whether the publication met the transfer timeliness target, as a percentage

datatake_id.description: Identifier of the datatake (acquisition segment) the product belongs to

absolute_orbit.description: Absolute orbit number during which the product was acquired

instrument_mode.description: Instrument acquisition mode of the product

product_level.description: Processing level of the product, resolved from the dataflow configuration

product_class.description: Product class parsed from the product name (S1-specific)

product_granularity.description: Product granularity parsed from the product name (S2-specific)

product_type.description: Product type as parsed from the product name

quality_control.description: Quality control status of the product

transfer_timeliness.description: Time elapsed between origin date and publication date, in microseconds

from_sensing_timeliness.description: Time elapsed between sensing end date and publication date, in microseconds

site_center.description: Processing/production centre that generated the product

timeliness.description: Timeliness category of the product (e.g. NRT, NTC), inherited from its datatake for S1/S2

relative_orbit.description: Relative orbit number during which the product was acquired

processor_version.description: Version of the processor that generated the product

product_discriminator_date.description: Product discriminator (creation) date used to distinguish reprocessed products

tile_number.description: S2 tile (granule) number parsed from the product name (S2-specific)

deletion_issue.description: Jira/CAMS issue key that triggered the deletion of this publication

deletion_date.description: Date the publication was deleted from the service

deletion_cause.description: Cause of the publication deletion, as reported by the deletion issue

cams_tickets.description: Identifiers of the CAMS anomaly tickets correlated to this publication

datatake_cams_ticket.description: CAMS anomaly ticket propagated from the publication's datatake

last_attached_ticket.description: Identifier of the most recently attached CAMS anomaly ticket

last_attached_ticket_url.description: URL of the most recently attached CAMS anomaly ticket

cams_origin.description: Origin (root cause category) reported by the attached CAMS anomaly ticket

cams_description.description: Description of the attached CAMS anomaly ticket

product_group_id.description: Product group identifier used to link related products (e.g. S2 datastrip/granule grouping)

datastrip_id.description: Identifier of the datastrip the product is associated with

quality_status.description: Quality status of the product as reported by the source interface

cloud_cover.description: Cloud cover percentage of the product
